artifacts.bundle_name: Court Filing Bundle — Alton C. Jennings Will Challenge

sub_items.description: Court petition filed December 2024 challenging the last will and testament and trust of Alton C. Jennings, naming Turning Point USA and Young America's Foundation as recipients of a redirected estate.

Host-narrated reference to Paul E. Valli (Valerie) as a Turning Point USA board member, described as former military commander of the 7th Psychological Operations Group, with two Vietnam combat tours and postings in Japan, Korea, Iraq, Israel, and Europe.
Reference to the 1980 book *Mind War* co-authored by Paul Valli and Major Michael Aquino.
Audio interview clip of Michael Aquino describing the Temple of Set's stated philosophical goals (exploring consciousness, Egyptian religious framework).

Host-narrated reference to Aquino joining the Church of Satan in 1969, rising to Magister Caverns of the fourth degree, editing *The Cloven Hoof*, and leaving in 1975 to found the Temple of Set after the LaVey/schism.
Reference to a 1986 San Francisco Police Department investigation into Michael Aquino in connection with the Army Child Development Center.
Reference to a 1987 victim identification of Aquino; case closed for insufficient evidence despite victim describing the house involved.
Article reference reporting twelve lawsuits filed against Harvest Christian Fellowship and Greg Laurie in connection with alleged abuse at a children's home in Bucharest, Romania.

Reference to original September lawsuit by two men against former Harvest pastor/missionary Paul Hascgard (Habsgard) alleging abuse at the Romanian children's shelter, including children tied to radiators, kneeling on walnut shells, inappropriate touching, and sex trafficking.
Reference to law firm news release stating twenty-three former residents of the home are expected to bring complaints; most recent complaints filed November (year implicit in context).
News reference to the death of Scott Adams (Dilbert creator) at age 68 from prostate cancer, with host noting he stated he was "coming to the Lord" before death.

artifacts.bundle_name: Social Blade Instagram Purge Data Bundle

sub_items.description: Reference (host-cited) to Social Blade data showing Erica Kirk deleted 126 Instagram posts on June 19, framed in context of the master timeline.
Comment from Andrew (Anthony) Aguilar — self-identified Gaza whistleblower Green Beret — stating he was arrested on September 3 in Congress for calling out AIPAC and offering to appear on the show.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk Argued Against Broader US Military Involvement in Iran
claims.claim: Charlie Kirk, in his own recorded words, argued against broader US military engagement with Iran and against neocon calls for regime change.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain primary recording and timestamp; verify quote against original source; confirm date of recording.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk Criticized Lindsey Graham's Iran Regime-Change Rhetoric
claims.claim: Charlie Kirk criticized Lindsey Graham's call for regime change in Iran as analogous to Hillary Clinton's Libya intervention.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain primary recording; verify exact phrasing.

claims.label: Court Petition Filed December 2024 Challenges Alton C. Jennings Will Against TPUSA and YAF
claims.claim: A court petition was filed in December 2024 by Alton C. Jennings's grandson, challenging the last will and trust on the grounds of cognitive decline and undue influence by caretaker Mitch Manley Sr.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain docket records (case number, court, jurisdiction); verify filing date and parties; confirm allegations are pleaded in the petition.

claims.label: Alton C. Jennings Estate Valued at $25M; Will Changed November 2023, Four Months Before Death
claims.claim: Alton C. Jennings's estate was valued at $25 million, and his will was reportedly changed in November 2023 — approximately four months before his death at age 95.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain probate court filings; verify valuation and date of will execution.

claims.label: Mitch Manley Jr. Worked on Charlie Kirk's TPUSA Show While His Father Was Caretaker
claims.claim: Mitch Manley Jr. (son of caretaker Mitch Manley Sr.) was employed by Turning Point USA on Charlie Kirk's show during the period his father was serving as Alton Jennings's caretaker.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify employment records; cross-check TPUSA staff listings; obtain dates of employment.

claims.label: Jennings Estate Reportedly Split Between Turning Point Action and YAF
claims.claim: The redirected Jennings estate was reportedly split between Turning Point Action (headed by Tyler Bowyer) and Young America's Foundation (YAF).
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain probate records reflecting beneficiary designations; verify allocation.

claims.label: Paul Valli Is a TPUSA Board Member and Former Commander of the 7th PSYOP Group
claims.claim: Paul E. Valli (Valerie) is identified as a Turning Point USA board member, with a military background as commander of the 7th Psychological Operations Group and two Vietnam combat tours.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify TPUSA board membership via official TPUSA disclosures; cross-check military service record.

claims.label: Valli and Aquino Co-Authored *Mind War* in 1980
claims.claim: Paul Valli and Major Michael Aquino co-authored the book *Mind War* in 1980.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain bibliographic record (publisher, ISBN); verify authorship.

claims.label: Michael Aquino Joined the Church of Satan in 1969
claims.claim: Michael Aquino joined the Church of Satan in 1969 and rose within its hierarchy.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check Aquino's published biographical statements; consult Church of Satan archives.

claims.label: Aquino Founded the Temple of Set in 1975
claims.claim: Michael Aquino left the Church of Satan in 1975 and founded the Temple of Set after a doctrinal dispute over whether Satan was literal or metaphorical.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify founding documents; cross-check Temple of Set records.

claims.label: SF Police Investigated Aquino in 1986 re: Army Child Development Center
claims.claim: In 1986, San Francisco police opened an investigation into Michael Aquino in connection with allegations of sexual abuse at the Army's Child Development Center in San Francisco.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain SFPD case records (case number); verify closure status and stated reason.

claims.label: 1987 Victim Identified Aquino; Case Closed for Insufficient Evidence
claims.claim: In 1987, a girl came forward identifying Aquino as the perpetrator, but the case was closed for insufficient evidence, despite the victim reportedly describing the house where abuse occurred.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain SFPD records; review any subsequent civil filings; cross-check victim statements if available.

claims.label: Twelve Lawsuits Filed Against Harvest Christian Fellowship re: Romanian Children's Home
claims.claim: Twelve lawsuits have been filed against Harvest Christian Fellowship and Greg Laurie alleging abuse of young men at a children's home in Romania.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain court filings (case numbers, jurisdiction); verify plaintiff count.

claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original complaint; verify specificity of allegations; confirm Hascgard's status (former pastor/missionary).
